swordplay_pommel_strike.name: Pommel Strike
swordplay_pommel_strike.description: Strike at close range for modest Blunt damage and briefly disrupt the target.

swordplay_whirlwind.name: Whirlwind
swordplay_whirlwind.description: Spend heavy Stamina to strike every hostile adjacent to you.

swordplay_execute.name: Execute
swordplay_execute.description: Attack at close range. Below 35% Health, the strike deals severe bonus damage; a kill restores Stamina.

swordplay_impale.name: Impale
swordplay_impale.description: Thrust along a clear straight line up to three tiles, piercing the target and one foe behind it.

swordplay_advance.name: Advance
swordplay_advance.description: Strike a nearby foe, then step into its tile if it dies or is driven away and the space is clear.

swordplay_reposition.name: Reposition
swordplay_reposition.description: Strike a nearby foe, then make one legal step to a safer adjacent tile.

swordplay_driving_blow.name: Driving Blow
swordplay_driving_blow.description: Hit at close range and drive the target up to two tiles away; walls or actors stop the shove and cause a collision.

swordplay_blade_rush.name: Blade Rush
swordplay_blade_rush.description: Choose a clear straight route up to four tiles. Rush to the first hostile and strike; blocked cells stop the charge.

swordplay_parry.name: Parry
swordplay_parry.description: Brace for the next incoming melee strike. It sharply reduces that hit, but does not counterattack.

swordplay_thrust.name: Thrust
swordplay_thrust.description: Make a precise straight thrust at a visible enemy up to two tiles away. A clear line is required.

swordplay_feint.name: Feint
swordplay_feint.description: Deal slight damage and leave the foe Exposed; your next sword hit against it deals increased damage.

swordplay_disengage.name: Disengage
swordplay_disengage.description: Strike at close range, then retreat up to two legal steps away from the target.

swordplay_overhead_strike.name: Overhead Strike
swordplay_overhead_strike.description: Deliver a committed blow that ignores some armor and gains extra force against heavily armored foes.

swordplay_sweeping_blow.name: Sweeping Blow
swordplay_sweeping_blow.description: Strike the three-tile frontal arc and push each foe away; collisions can stun and deal extra damage.

swordplay_reckless_swing.name: Reckless Swing
swordplay_reckless_swing.description: Hit nearby foes in a wide arc for heavy damage, then become Off Balance and take increased damage until your next action.

swordplay_blade_dance.name: Blade Dance
swordplay_blade_dance.description: Move along a legal route of up to three tiles, striking nearby foes as you pass. Walls and occupied cells stop you.

swordplay_executioners_stroke.name: Executioner's Stroke
swordplay_executioners_stroke.description: A stricter finishing cut. A kill below 40% Health restores 16 Stamina and shortens this technique's cooldown.

swordplay_skewer.name: Skewer
swordplay_skewer.description: Thrust along a clear line up to four tiles, piercing up to three enemies.

swordplay_perfect_parry.name: Perfect Parry
swordplay_perfect_parry.description: Perfectly negate the next incoming melee attack and strongly disrupt its attacker. It never counters automatically.

swordplay_unstoppable_charge.name: Unstoppable Charge
swordplay_unstoppable_charge.description: Rush up to six tiles in a clear line, striking enemies along the route and continuing through foes you kill.

swordplay_battering_blow.name: Battering Blow
swordplay_battering_blow.description: Drive one foe up to three tiles. Wall or actor collisions deal heavy bonus damage and stun.

swordplay_berserkers_arc.name: Berserker's Arc
swordplay_berserkers_arc.description: A larger frontal sweep deals severe damage, then leaves you Off Balance and vulnerable through the next enemy action.

swordplay_transfixing_charge.name: Transfixing Charge
swordplay_transfixing_charge.description: Charge along a clear line and pierce up to three enemies. Requires Lunge and Impale; neither is consumed.

swordplay_sundering_sweep.name: Sundering Sweep
swordplay_sundering_sweep.description: Sweep the frontal arc and drive foes back with powerful collision force. Requires Cleave and Driving Blow.

swordplay_relentless_advance.name: Relentless Advance
swordplay_relentless_advance.description: Execute a weakened foe, then advance into its vacated tile. A kill restores 6 Stamina; momentum never creates an extra attack.

swordplay_masterstroke.name: Masterstroke
swordplay_masterstroke.description: Set a precise exposed mark and brace against the next melee strike. It does not counterattack. Requires Parry and Feint.

swordplay_dancing_steel.name: Dancing Steel
swordplay_dancing_steel.description: Move up to three legal tiles and strike nearby hostiles along the route. Requires Whirlwind and Reposition.

swordplay_armor_splitter.name: Armor Splitter
swordplay_armor_splitter.description: Concentrate a piercing blow that ignores most armor and deals extra damage to armored foes. Requires Overhead Strike and Impale.

swordplay_parting_thrust.name: Parting Thrust
swordplay_parting_thrust.description: Retreat up to two legal steps while thrusting through a clear line up to three tiles. Requires Disengage and Thrust.

swordplay_great_cleaver.name: Great Cleaver
swordplay_great_cleaver.description: A huge frontal displacement attack that leaves you Off Balance. Requires Sweeping Blow and Reckless Swing.

rapier.name: Rapier
rapier.description: A light one-handed sword with two-tile reach. Its quick thrusts favor Mobility and Precision.

goblinbane.name: Goblinbane
goblinbane.description: A balanced sword that deals extra damage to Goblinoids. A Goblinoid kill with it shortens technique cooldowns.

needle.name: Needle
needle.description: A quick rapier that lets Thrust reach into deeper lines. It grants Thrust while equipped; removing it removes only that temporary grant.

headsmans_mercy.name: Headsman's Mercy
headsmans_mercy.description: A slow Greatsword that makes Execute effective against healthier foes, at the cost of weaker ordinary attacks.

wayfarers_blade.name: Wayfarer's Blade
wayfarers_blade.description: A light sword that reduces Stamina costs for techniques that move you.

stonebreaker.name: Stonebreaker
stonebreaker.description: A committed Greatsword that breaks armor and deals more damage when a forced movement ends in a collision.

second_hand.name: The Second Hand
second_hand.description: After a sword technique, your next basic attack gains bonus damage. This rhythm uses no Time magic.

cowards_end.name: Coward's End
cowards_end.description: A long rapier that deals extra damage to foes left Unbalanced by displacement or collision.

bloodless_edge.name: Bloodless Edge
bloodless_edge.description: Each unhurt action builds temporary Precision, adding damage to sword attacks. Taking damage clears the benefit.

oathkeeper.name: Oathkeeper
oathkeeper.description: A defensive sword that further reduces a successfully parried melee hit, while ordinary attacks deal less damage.

swordplay_sword_of_the_goblin_horde.name: Sword of the Goblin Horde
swordplay_sword_of_the_goblin_horde.description: Your first sword technique each encounter costs 8 less Stamina. Technique kills briefly stack a martial damage bonus.

swordplay_offhand_sword.name: Offhand Sword
swordplay_offhand_sword.description: A second one-handed sword. Dual-wield attacks add a lighter offhand hit but cost more Stamina and time; a two-handed weapon occupies both hands.

duelist.name: The Duelist
duelist.class_description: A precise swordsman who favors measured technique.
duelist.unlock_requirement: Successfully Parry 5 melee attacks in one run.

fencer.name: The Fencer
fencer.class_description: A mobile Rapier fighter built for reach and precision.
fencer.unlock_requirement: Move successfully with sword techniques 8 times in one run.

berserker.name: The Berserker
berserker.class_description: A committed Greatsword fighter built for heavy offense.
berserker.unlock_requirement: Defeat the Sword Lord of the Goblin Horde.

goblin_swordsman.name: Goblin Swordsman
goblin_swordsman.description: A straightforward Goblin fighter who closes in and tests a clear line before thrusting.

goblin_fencer.name: Goblin Fencer
goblin_fencer.description: A quick skirmisher that lunges to close, thrusts at reach, then withdraws when cornered.

goblin_blade_dancer.name: Goblin Blade Dancer
goblin_blade_dancer.description: A mobile area threat that waits for clustered heroes before spinning through nearby targets.

kobold_duelist.name: Kobold Duelist
kobold_duelist.description: A precise fighter who parries after being pressed, then marks a foe with a Feint.

kobold_skirmisher.name: Kobold Skirmisher
kobold_skirmisher.description: Uses two-tile reach and withdraws only when adjacent to a threat.

orc_cleaver.name: Orc Cleaver
orc_cleaver.description: A heavy area attacker that uses wide arcs when surrounded.

orc_breaker.name: Orc Breaker
orc_breaker.description: A slow armored threat that leans on armor pressure, knockback, and collisions.

orc_berserker.name: Orc Berserker
orc_berserker.description: An aggressive fighter that commits to a dangerous swing or rush when it can connect.

goblin_bladeguard.name: Goblin Bladeguard
goblin_bladeguard.description: An elite guard who parries a blow aimed at it and uses controlled displacement.

sword_lord_goblin_horde.name: Sword Lord of the Goblin Horde
sword_lord_goblin_horde.description: A rare master who changes tactics with distance, pressure, and the hero's condition.

swordplay_goblin_court.name: Goblin Blade Court
swordplay_goblin_court.subtitle: Training scars cross the stone floor.

swordplay_kobold_duel_yard.name: Kobold Duel Yard
swordplay_kobold_duel_yard.subtitle: Narrow lanes reward patience and timing.

swordplay_orc_foundry.name: Orc Sword Foundry
swordplay_orc_foundry.subtitle: Heavy blades ring against the forge stone.

swordplay_blade_warrens.name: Blade Warrens
swordplay_blade_warrens.subtitle: Goblins and their rivals train beyond the old warrens.

sword_lord_of_the_goblin_horde.name: Sword Lord of the Goblin Horde
sword_lord_of_the_goblin_horde.description: A rare, dangerous Goblin master. His movement, parries, lines and executions make him more than a wall of Health.

swordplay_stride_medallion.name: Stride Medallion
swordplay_stride_medallion.description: The first successful movement technique each turn restores 3 Stamina.

swordplay_mirror_guard.name: Mirror Guard
swordplay_mirror_guard.description: After a successful Parry, gain Guard against the next hit and restore 3 Stamina.

swordplay_low_crescent.name: Low Crescent
swordplay_low_crescent.description: Execute and its evolutions can finish foes at 8% more Health.

swordplay_long_measure.name: Long Measure
swordplay_long_measure.description: Thrust and Impale reach one tile farther when a clear line remains.

swordplay_killing_rhythm.name: Killing Rhythm
swordplay_killing_rhythm.description: A technique that hits at least two enemies restores 4 Stamina for each enemy beyond the first.

swordplay_martial_chart.name: Martial Chart
swordplay_martial_chart.description: Sword, Martial, and Precision rewards gain modestly more weight.

swordplay_alternating_seal.name: Alternating Seal
swordplay_alternating_seal.description: Alternating basic attacks and sword techniques grants a small damage bonus to the next action.

swordplay_opening_buckle.name: Opening Buckle
swordplay_opening_buckle.description: The first sword technique after entering a stage costs 5 less Stamina.

swordplay_arc_of_blades.name: Arc of Blades
swordplay_arc_of_blades.description: Your basic sword attacks also clip one additional adjacent hostile for reduced damage.

swordplay_perfect_timing.name: Perfect Timing
swordplay_perfect_timing.description: Parry fully negates a melee hit and stuns its attacker, but all sword techniques cost 25% more Stamina.

swordplay_collision_engine.name: Collision Engine
swordplay_collision_engine.description: Forced movement travels one tile farther and collisions deal 12 additional damage.

swordplay_endless_form.name: Endless Form
swordplay_endless_form.description: The first sword technique each encounter costs no Stamina. It can trigger only once until the next stage.
